note: Albums of the school gallery (https://playpen.edu.bd/photo-gallery/), in the order of the school site. Read by build/gallery_albums.py. Added 2026-10-24 (review r1): 'hold_note' on an album explains why its screened frame is held back for a reason other than consent (Foundation Day: the cake's age count).
